request: SUE-1726 round 6: October hold pricing versus December hike pricing from supplied Kalshi PMC live markets.

theme.font_family: 'Noto Sans KR', 'Noto Sans CJK KR', sans-serif

artifact.primary_job: Carry one primary information function — orient, assert, show evidence, explain mechanism, compare, qualify, turn, show consequence, or close — as one frame in a beat-ordered sequence (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §1).

composition.dominant_structure: Primary assertion followed by primary evidence, in that order (Assertion-Evidence profile, SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §2).
composition.reading_path: Assertion, then evidence, then only the interpreting text needed.
composition.chrome_level: low; layout tokens and responsive behavior belong to the renderer, not the editorial spec (SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §10)

acceptance: the frame's main point can be stated in one sentence
the title/assertion matches the evidence shown
the frame maps to one or more beat_id entries

requirements: self-contained without narration when density profile is silent_carousel
mobile legibility is critical for carousel surfaces

readability.rationale: SLIDES-AND-CAROUSELS.md §4 makes mobile legibility a hard requirement of the silent_carousel density profile, and it generalizes the SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5 mobile-gate principle to sequential frames.

surface.geometry_rule: Portrait is a recipe default, not a platform mandate. Explicit task geometry wins when compatible with the actual destination.
surface.readability: Check actual full-size and mobile pixels. Text budgets are soft; never delete essential qualifiers or shrink indefinitely to fit.
surface.overflow: Re-layout, move nonessential detail to caption, or split into a declared series; no silent truncation.
surface.voice_boundary: Personal caption defaults do not force on-image headlines or other accounts into a personal-reflective voice.

resolved_requirements.density_review: Declared intent, not measured coverage. Review actual semantic/visual density; explicit slots own geometry.

layers.instruction:
R4 owner-preferred photo-led editorial direction. Use the supplied strong source photo as the full-bleed visual whenever present, preserving the original pixels and recording crop/focal-point decisions. Keep factual text in the existing deterministic compositor regions. Do not replace a suitable photo with generated illustration. If a usable photo is absent or weak, resolve to R7 before rendering.
Frame purpose: 동결과 인상은 원·달러와 변동형 주택대출금리에 서로 다른 압력을 준다.
Full-saturation editorial photo of a blank paper calendar and navy pen in warm light; no dates, text, numbers, logos, people, UI or watermark.
Create only the illustration for the content slot {"x":0,"y":0,"width":1,"height":1}. The compositor clips this asset to that slot; it adds headline, source, page count and watermark separately. Do not draw exact text, data, numbers or branding. A prompt alone is not pixel reservation.

layers.font_family: 'Noto Serif KR', 'Noto Serif CJK KR', serif
